data.narrative:
Scale AI is a private-stage AI & Software company founded by Alexandr Wang and Lucy Guo, currently valued at $29B with $14.8B in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 8 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables, including private companies such as Waymo ($126.0B), Figure AI ($39.0B), Reflection AI ($25.0B), Applied Intuition ($15.0B), and Skild AI ($14.0B), alongside one public comparable (Palantir).

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $14.5B. This median is calculated across the 8-company peer universe, which exhibits substantial dispersion: the range spans from $8.3B at the floor to $126.0B at the ceiling, reflecting heterogeneity in business model maturity and stage within the AI sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $12.3B to $16.7B, centered on a median of $14.5B. Scale AI's current $29B valuation sits materially above this range. The primary source of uncertainty is the limited methodological diversity—only peer-median analysis is applicable with the available dataset. Resolution of this gap requires either revised comparables reflecting Scale AI's specific revenue scale and unit economics, or additional triangulation methods such as discounted cash flow or revenue multiples, which cannot be applied without operating metrics and financial projections.
